title: queltia × sabinii
intro: Queltia × sabinii, commonly known as Queltia sabinii, is a hybrid plant species within the Quelisiae genus, derived from the Quelisia and Sabinia genera. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Queltia × sabinii include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Queltia × sabinii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
